title: Quantum Fragmentation
summary: We introduce a systematic protocol for constructing quantum Hilbert-space-fragmented Hamiltonians, whose Krylov-sector structure, unlike in classically fragmented models, can be fully resolved only in an entangled basis. The protocol takes as input a classically fragmented model and uses a Rokhsar-Kivelson type construction to promote it to a quantum fragmented model. Notably, the procedure also works with non-fragmented inputs (such as Ising models).
